Hi Alex & Priya,

Thanks again for your time earlier — great to learn more about FinBank's fraud-detection use cases and the need for predictable latency and strong PII controls. Quick recap:
- Primary use case: real-time transaction monitoring (sub-250ms target for scoring).
- Data concerns: PII redaction, in-region processing, SOC 2 evidence requested.
- Success metrics: latency SLOs, unit token cost targets, and model explainability for compliance.

Next step: we'd like to schedule a 30-min product intro / demo so we can show the runtime, routing/fallbacks, and the security controls (VPC/KMS options). Please pick one of these 30-min windows (all PST):
1) Tue Feb 16 — 10:30–11:00 AM PST
2) Wed Feb 17 — 2:00–2:30 PM PST
3) Thu Feb 18 — 9:00–9:30 AM PST

If none of those work, tell me a couple times that do and we'll find something. Also please let me know which stakeholders you want on the call (technical lead, security/compliance, procurement).

Attached: redwood-intro-deck.pdf (high-level), redwood-demo-agenda.docx (short 30-min agenda).

Proposed agenda (30 min):
- 5m: intros & goals
- 10m: product demo (latency numbers, routing, KV/prefix caching)
- 10m: security & deployment options (Dedicated vs Private)
- 5m: next steps / mutual action plan

Thanks — I'll send a calendar invite once we confirm a slot.

Best,
